shortDefinition: Meta's open-weights large language model family, widely used for local AI and research.
fullDefinition: Llama (Large Language Model Meta AI) is a family of open-weights language models released by Meta AI. Llama 2 and Llama 3 are among the most widely used open models globally. Because the weights are publicly available, Llama powers many local AI setups (via Ollama, LM Studio), fine-tuning experiments, and derivative models. Llama models range from 1B to 70B+ parameters.
